title: A RUN_NOW style variable reruns the job on every Railway redeploy
symptoms: The job runs and emails again after every deploy
Unexpected runs right after variable changes
cause: Setting a variable triggers a redeploy, and a flag read at boot fires on every later boot too. Deleting a variable does not trigger a redeploy.
fix: Delete the flag right after the manual run. Audit services for leftover flags.
apply: railway variables --json | node -e "const v=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0)); for (const k of Object.keys(v)) if (/RUN.*NOW/.test(k)) console.log(k, v[k] === 'true')"
